notes.title: BLOODY SERVICE IS 30% OFF
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iZQMYGM.gif[/img]

Until February 15th, [u][b]BLOODY SERVICE IS 30% OFF[/b][/u] as a part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale.

Bloody Service is our first game released on Steam as CASE (we come from different studios and we've been making games for quite some time now). 

So...

This is a perfect time to grab the game and experience a slasher FMV visual novel that pays homage to horror from the 70s/80s and to that whole FMV fever from the 90s!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415020/Bloody_Service/][u][b]GRAB IT HERE![/b][/u][/url]

Note: Have you played the demo for The Parrot That Summons Demons? What do you think?

[b][u]And remember! [/u][/b]
You can find us on [url=https://twitter.com/Case80s]Twitter[/url] and/or [url=https://discord.gg/C2B4WRe]Discord[/url] (We're sharing exclusive material on Discord, chatting about horror in books, movies and games and just having a good eerie time. Come join us!)

notes.title: Try out a new FMV adventure in the The Parrot That Summons Demons demo
notes.notes:
Mixing together FMV with a Visual Novel adventure, The Parrot That Summons Demons will be bringing the deep, dark and unsettling story by the creators of Bloody Service to Linux.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/02/try-out-a-new-fmv-adventure-in-the-the-parrot-that-summons-demons-demo

notes.title: Demo available now!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We are participating in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamgamefestival]Steam Games Festival[/url] with the demo of The Parrot That Summons Demons... And guess what? It's already available for download (Win, Mac and Linux).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IZOMEAN.gif[/img]

The game is currently in development and this demo features two small chapters from Samantha’s timeline—Samantha is McCauley's older daughter. Full game is going to feature multiple chapters for every member of the McCauley family.

If you like the game, please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Case80s]twitter[/url], spread the word and come hang with us in [url=https://discord.com/invite/C2B4WRe]our discord server[/url].

notes.title: Meet Alejandro!
notes.notes:
[h3]What would Freud think?[/h3]

[i]Alejandro[/i] is father of three members of our studio—[i]Chavo[/i], [i]Augusto[/i] and [i]me[/i]—so we've decided to model him in 3D. Now he's one of the four main characters of [b]The Parrot That Summons Demons[/b] (and our pet actor!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YzHT8KG.gif[/img]

I mean, [b]The Parrot That Summons Demons[/b] can be described as a family tragedy/horror game, so what's better than including members of our actual family in our own game? 

Nothing can go wrong, right?

RIGHT?

notes.title: While you wait for demons to be summoned...
notes.notes:
We're working on getting The Parrot That Summons Demons out there... Meanwhile you can get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415020/Bloody_Service/]Bloody Service[/url], our slasher FMV visual novel about conjoined twins and tennis. Bloody Service is not only a deranged love letter to 80s slashers but the first game on our catalogue!
